heroTitle: Mask Personal Data Before It Reaches Your AI.
heroBody: Maskera finds and masks names, personal identity numbers, addresses and phone numbers in text before it reaches AI systems, logs or analytics tools. Built for Swedish text and Swedish personal data.

products.title: Browser Extension
products.body: Masks right inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity and Mistral, in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. Free to start. Pro and Team add more AI redactions, your own protected words and rollout across the organization.

products.title: AI Agents
products.body: A local proxy and MCP server in front of agents like Claude Code and Codex, so only masked text reaches the model. Open source.

products.title: Your Own Code
products.body: npm packages for web apps and Node services: fixed rules with zero dependencies, or the rules together with the Swedish AI model. Open source.

useCases.title: AI Systems
useCases.body: Send prompts and documents to AI models without leaking names, personal identity numbers or contact details.

useCases.title: Logs
useCases.body: Keep your logs useful for debugging, minus the personal data.

useCases.title: Analytics
useCases.body: Feed analytics and BI tools with text that is free of personal data.

detectBody: Each item is swapped for a placeholder like [NAMN_1] or [PERSONNUMMER_1]. The key to restore them stays on your side, so the AI model’s answer can be filled back in with the real values, locally.

detectGroups.title: Free Text
detectGroups.body: My own 43 MB Swedish AI model catches what rules never can: names, places, organizations and street addresses, even in lowercase, all caps and genitive forms, the way people actually type.

detectGroups.title: Structured Data
detectGroups.body: Rules with format checks and checksums, so something like 2019-2024 is never mistaken for a bankgiro number. Your own formats, like case or customer numbers, join as rules of their own.

principles.title: Runs Locally
principles.body: Masking happens in the browser, in the extension or in your own Node process. The text and the key that restores it are never sent to Maskera.

principles.title: Built for GDPR
principles.body: Masking personal data early is data minimization for real: less data to protect, fewer systems in scope.

principles.title: Simple to Integrate
principles.body: A straightforward API that fits the flows you already have: before the AI call, before the log write, before the export.

openBody: The core of Maskera is open: the code is on GitHub, the packages on npm and the NER model on Hugging Face. You don’t have to take my word for how it works, you can read it and run it before you talk to me.
